```yaml
name: Update Nix vendor hash

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-vendorhash:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
        with:
          install_url: https://releases.nixos.org/nix/nix-2.17.0/install

      - name: Lint update-vendorhash script
        run: bash -n scripts/update-vendorhash.sh

      - name: Get changed dependency files
        id: changed
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json
          filter: '^(go\.mod|go\.sum)$'

      - name: Run vendor hash update
        if: steps.changed.outputs.modified != '' || steps.changed.outputs.added != ''
        run: |
          bash scripts/update-vendorhash.sh

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.changed.outputs.modified != '' || steps.changed.outputs.added != ''
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore: update Nix vendorHash"

      - name: Push changes to PR branch
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && (steps.changed.outputs.modified != '' || steps.changed.outputs.added != '')
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.head_ref }}

      - name: Create temporary branch for PR dispatch
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (steps.changed.outputs.modified != '' || steps.changed.outputs.added != '')
        run: |
          git checkout -b update-vendorhash-${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Push temporary branch
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (steps.changed.outputs.modified != '' || steps.changed.outputs.added != '')
        run: |
          git push origin update-vendorhash-${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Create PR for vendor hash update
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (steps.changed.outputs.modified != '' || steps.changed.outputs.added != '')
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: update-vendorhash-${{ github.run_id }}
          base: main
          title: "chore: update Nix vendorHash"
          body: |
            Automated update of the Nix `vendorHash` due to changes in Go dependencies.
          commit-message: "chore: update Nix vendorHash"
          signoff: true
```
